global_prompt: A polished cinematic short film with restrained camera motion, realistic materials, natural body mechanics, and stable character appearance across all shots.

continuity.characters: The main character keeps the same face, age, hairstyle, body proportions, wardrobe, and accessories throughout the entire video.
continuity.environment: The same world, architecture, time of day, and spatial layout persist unless a shot explicitly changes them.
continuity.lighting: Soft warm key light from camera left, cool ambient fill, physically plausible shadows, and no unexplained exposure jumps.
continuity.camera: Cinematic 16:9 framing, coherent screen direction, one dominant camera motion per shot, and no accidental lens or viewpoint changes.
continuity.color: Consistent neutral film grade with slightly warm highlights and natural skin tones.
continuity.audio: Continuous room tone with clearly timed dialogue and restrained environmental effects; never add an unrelated speaker.
continuity.music: A low-volume atmospheric score that evolves gradually and does not restart at each continuation boundary.

shots.prompt: A wide establishing shot introduces the environment. The character enters slowly from frame left and pauses near the window, looking toward the distant city lights.
The camera performs a slow push-in as the character crosses the room, picks up a small object from the table, and begins a quiet spoken line. Preserve the previously established screen direction.
Cut to a controlled medium close-up of the hands and the mechanical watch. The character opens the watch, studies the moving gears, and continues the same line without changing voice or wardrobe.
Return to the character's face in the same room. The expression changes from uncertainty to resolve while the watch remains visible in one hand. Use a gentle lateral camera move, not a sudden zoom.
The character walks toward the window as the outside lights begin to brighten. The camera follows from behind and then settles into a balanced profile composition.

Hold the final profile composition. The character finishes the dialogue, closes the watch, and looks toward the horizon. End on a stable natural pose with the established lighting and music resolving gently.
